create_checkpoint_dataloader: create a CheckpointDataLoader to resume PyTorch training from a saved checkpoint mid-epoch
create_random_sampler: create a RandomSampler that generates a random permutation of dataset indices for shuffled training
create_sequential_sampler: create a SequentialSampler that returns dataset indices in sequential order for ordered iteration
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a checkpoint by passing batch_idx and dataset_perm to CheckpointDataLoader
review_sampler_checkpoint_logic: review the RandomSampler and SequentialSampler checkpoint resume logic that slices dataset_perm by batch position
